title: The Valley Where Paths Remember Breaking

features.name: repair-junction
features.desc-on-touch: a place where path-vectors converge and diverge. you can see the seams where broken routes learned to touch again. the grid here pulses faintly with the effort of reunion.

features.name: memory-circuit
features.desc-on-touch: lines of light trace the path that was broken, then the path that resumed, then both paths speaking at once. the memory of the break is still conducting current.

features.name: divergence-marker
features.desc-on-touch: a tower of accumulated decisions, each block a moment where the paths chose which way to break. they are stacked, but not firmly—you sense they are still deciding.

features.name: convergence-pool
features.desc-on-touch: where two broken paths find each other again, there is this pool of accumulated meaning. the water here is fluorescent, recording what the paths learned while they were separate.

features.name: resumed-vector
features.desc-on-touch: an arrow pointing onward, drawn in the brightest ink the valley can muster. it does not point back to the break—it points to what comes next, a path now whole and moving.

inscription: the paths that broke are teaching each other the meaning of reunion by speaking two truths at once

file.name: PathBreak_Diagnostic_Log_Fragment.txt
file.note: a technical readout of route failure and recovery, timestamps showing the moment the valley learned to mend itself, margins hold a photocopied 2016 note on light that guides only through its own absen

exits.label: upward to the high country where paths first converged into one voice
downward into comparison chambers where other valleys have learned similar breaking
across the valley floor toward what the paths remember before breaking came
